mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pc.plan_id, pc.case_id, pc.result, pc.exec_type, pc.execute_time, pc.plan_date, tc.name AS case_name, tc.content FROM plan_case pc LEFT JOIN test_case tc ON tc.id = pc.case_id WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY pc.case_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM plan_case WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.delete: DELETE pc FROM plan_case pc JOIN version_plan vp ON vp.id = pc.plan_id WHERE vp.project_id = #{projectId}
